label: Poliphilo in the Dark Forest
description: Poliphilo wanders among tall trees in a dense forest. Small figure at center surrounded by towering trunks with detailed foliage.
narrative_context: The opening scene of the HP. Poliphilo, having fallen asleep weeping for his beloved Polia, finds himself lost in a dark and terrifying forest — echoing Dante's selva oscura. This is the threshold between waking and dreaming.

label: Poliphilo at the Landscape with River
description: Poliphilo rests in an open landscape with trees and a stream. Pastoral scene with classical elements.
narrative_context: Having escaped the dark forest, Poliphilo enters a beautiful open landscape. He drinks from a stream and rests, transitioning from terror to wonder. The landscape represents the first stage of his allegorical journey.

label: Poliphilo Sleeping (Dream within Dream)
description: Poliphilo lies sleeping on the ground in a wooded landscape. A second dream begins within the first.
narrative_context: Poliphilo falls asleep again within his dream, initiating the dream-within-a-dream structure that is the HP's most distinctive narrative device. This second sleep takes him deeper into the allegorical realm.

label: Poliphilo in a Garden with Palms
description: Poliphilo stands in a garden setting with palm trees and classical vegetation.
narrative_context: Poliphilo awakens in a beautiful garden with exotic plants. The palms and ordered vegetation signal his entry into a civilized, designed landscape — architecture replacing wilderness.

label: The Great Pyramid
description: Full-page woodcut of a massive stepped pyramid topped by a tall obelisk surmounted by a figure. Colonnaded portico at the base. Inscription KITOMARNO visible.
narrative_context: The centerpiece of Poliphilo's first architectural encounter. This impossible pyramid exceeds the Egyptian originals in Colonna's description — its dimensions are meticulously specified and internally consistent, demonstrating the author's architectural learning.

label: The Ruined Colossal Horse
description: Fragments of a colossal bronze horse lying among ruins. One of the HP's most evocative images of ancient grandeur brought low.
narrative_context: Poliphilo discovers the ruins of an immense bronze horse — a symbol of imperial ambition and the transience of human achievement.

label: Twin Inscribed Monuments (D.AMBIG.D.D.)
description: Two rectangular stone pedestals with circular wreath inscriptions. Enigmatic Latin abbreviated text within each wreath.
narrative_context: Poliphilo encounters paired funerary monuments with cryptic inscriptions. The enigmatic abbreviations have generated centuries of scholarly debate.

label: Figures with TEMPVS
description: Group of classical figures, one labeled TEMPVS (Time). Allegorical scene with personified abstractions.
narrative_context: An allegorical group representing Time and associated concepts.

label: Classical Figures in a Garden
description: Group of figures in classical dress gathered in a garden or outdoor scene.
narrative_context: Poliphilo encounters allegorical figures in an idealized setting.

label: Inscription Monument (ΓΟΝΟΣ ΚΑΙ ΕΤΟΥΣΙΑ)
description: Stone stele with Greek and pseudo-Arabic inscriptions in an arched niche.
narrative_context: A multilingual monument displaying Greek, Arabic, and Hebrew-like characters. The inscription 'Offspring and Abundance' connects to fertility and generative power.

label: The Elephant and Obelisk
description: An elephant bearing an obelisk on a circular stepped pedestal. The obelisk is topped with a sphere and decorated with pseudo-hieroglyphic panels.
narrative_context: The most famous image in the HP. This combination directly inspired Bernini's 1667 sculpture in Piazza della Minerva, Rome. Union of strength (elephant) and wisdom (obelisk).

label: Figure on Monument with Greek Inscription
description: Standing figure atop a pedestal with Greek text. Classical architectural framing.
narrative_context: A monument combining human figure and Greek inscription.

label: Monument with Female Figure, Lamp, and Trilingual Inscriptions
description: Tall monument with standing female figure holding a lamp. Below: three tiers of inscriptions in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin capitals.
narrative_context: The most inscription-heavy page in the HP. Hebrew, Greek, and Latin texts encode warnings about a treasure.

label: Hieroglyphic Frieze
description: Two-register frieze with emblematic figures: chariots, winged beings, dolphins, anchors, vessels. Below: Latin majuscule inscription.
narrative_context: The first of the HP's pseudo-hieroglyphic friezes — Colonna's invented 'Egyptian' symbolic language.

label: Architectural Portal
description: Grand classical portal with pediment, columns, and medallion busts. Monumental entrance architecture.
narrative_context: A monumental doorway representing the threshold between different zones of Poliphilo's journey.

label: Ruins of the Temple
description: Ruined classical temple with broken columns and fragments. Poliphilo contemplates ancient remains.
narrative_context: Poliphilo encounters another ruin, continuing the theme of ancient grandeur.

label: Poliphilo at a Portal with Dragon
description: Poliphilo recoils from a dragon or beast emerging from a portal. Dramatic confrontation scene.
narrative_context: A moment of danger and wonder. The dragon guards a threshold — the beast connects to the 'bellua' alchemical annotations.

label: Emblematic Medallions (PATIENTIA / Anchor-Dolphin)
description: Two circular medallion emblems. Top: PATIENTIA EST ORNAMENTVM. Bottom: anchor-and-dolphin with Greek motto ΑΕΙ ΣΠΕΥΔΕ ΒΡΑΔΕΩΣ.
narrative_context: Two of the HP's most influential emblems. The patience motto and anchor-dolphin (festina lente) connect directly to the Aldine Press device.

label: Sleeping Nymph
description: A sleeping nymph reclining in a classical aedicule with water flowing from the stone. One of the HP's most copied compositions.
narrative_context: The sleeping nymph fountain is one of the most influential images in Renaissance art.

label: Five Nymphs Meeting Poliphilo
description: Five nymphs in classical dress approach Poliphilo in a garden. One extends a hand in greeting.
narrative_context: Poliphilo meets the five senses personified as nymphs.

label: Cupid on a Sphere
description: Winged putto (Cupid) standing on a sphere atop a fountain. Water arcs from the base.
narrative_context: Cupid/Eros presides over a fountain — love as the animating force of the natural world.

label: Three Figures in Aedicule
description: Three figures in an architectural niche with pediment.
narrative_context: An allegorical scene set within classical architecture.

label: The Great Fountain
description: Full-page woodcut of an elaborate tiered fountain. Three levels: sea-horses at base, grotesque masks and sphinxes at middle, nude Venus figure under arching water jets at top.
narrative_context: The most architecturally ambitious fountain in the HP. Its three tiers represent the three levels of being: marine, grotesque (transformation), and divine.

label: Queen Eleuterylida's Palace
description: Interior of ornate palace hall with columned arcade. Seven compartments labeled with planetary names: MERCVRIVS, VENVS, SOL, MARS, LVNA, IVPITER, SATVRNVS.
narrative_context: The palace of the seven planets — each compartment corresponds to a celestial body and its associated metal, gemstone, and virtue.

label: Palace Interior with Planetary Compartments
description: Detailed view of the planetary palace interior showing ornate facades with arabesque panels.
narrative_context: A second view of the planetary palace showing the decorative program in detail.

label: Court Scene with Queen Enthroned
description: Queen seated on throne under canopy, attended by courtiers and nymphs. Formal court reception scene.
narrative_context: Queen Eleuterylida receives Poliphilo. Her name means 'Freely-Given' — she represents generous hospitality.

label: Ornamental Tripod Table
description: Ornate classical tripod with decorative scrollwork and dolphin-form legs.
narrative_context: An architectural study of a classical tripod.

label: Covered Vessel on Wheeled Chariot
description: Small ornamental urn or covered vessel mounted on a wheeled chariot.
narrative_context: A ceremonial vessel, possibly for processions or ritual use.

label: Caryatid Figures Supporting Basin
description: Three female caryatid figures supporting a basin with harp-like decorative elements.
narrative_context: Caryatid architecture — female figures serving as structural columns — is one of the HP's recurring motifs.

label: Nymph at Fountain Vessel
description: Woman standing beside an elaborate fountain vessel on a wheeled platform.
narrative_context: A nymph associated with a mobile fountain, combining figural and architectural elements.

label: Obelisk with Three Figures
description: Tall obelisk with three standing figures in niches at its base. Greek and Latin inscriptions. DIVINAE AENINITATI visible.
narrative_context: A monument combining Egyptian (obelisk) and Greek elements.

label: Seated Scholar at Monument
description: Seated figure at a desk within a classical architectural frame with pediment and columns.
narrative_context: A scholar at work, housed within architecture.

label: Two Seated Figures at Pedestal with Medallion
description: Two seated figures on either side of a pedestal, with a circular medallion portrait above.
narrative_context: A scene of philosophical dialogue or instruction.

label: The Three Doors
description: Cave or grotto scene: figures before three inscribed doorways. Inscriptions: THEODOXIA, COSMODOXIA, EROTOTROPHOS.
narrative_context: The central allegory of the HP. Poliphilo must choose between three doors — he chooses the path of Eros.

label: Poliphilo at the Temple Entrance
description: Group of figures approaching a small classical building or temple. Landscape with trees.
narrative_context: Having chosen EROTOTROPHOS, Poliphilo enters the realm of love and beauty.

label: Nymphs and Figures Among Trees
description: Group of nymphs and figures standing among trees near a building or monument.
narrative_context: Poliphilo in the company of nymphs in a sacred grove.

label: Nymphs Walking Through a Grove
description: Group of nymphs and a central figure walking through a grove of trees.
narrative_context: A processional scene through a sacred landscape.

label: Garden with Pergola
description: Two figures standing in a garden with an arched pergola and trees.
narrative_context: A garden scene showing designed horticultural architecture.

label: First Triumphal Chariot (PRIMA TABELLA)
description: Two woodcut panels: PRIMA TABELLA showing a chariot with bulls and figures.
narrative_context: The beginning of the HP's most sustained visual sequence — a triumphal procession celebrating the victory of love.

label: Second Triumphal Panel
description: Two woodcut panels showing front and rear views of a triumphal chariot with classical figures.
narrative_context: Continuation of the procession with views showing the chariot from multiple angles.

label: Triumphal Chariot (TRIVMPHVS TERTIVS)
description: Large triumphal chariot drawn by centaurs with nymphs and musicians.
narrative_context: The third triumph, drawn by centaurs — half-human, half-horse beings representing the dual nature of desire.

label: Triumphal Chariot with Soldiers
description: Large triumphal chariot drawn by horses with soldiers, musicians, and banner-bearers.
narrative_context: A military-themed triumph with martial figures, connecting the procession of love to Roman triumphal traditions.

label: Muses and Apollo Chariot
description: Triumphal chariot with the Muses and Apollo, drawn by horses. Musical instruments and laurel wreaths visible.
narrative_context: The triumph of the arts and music.

label: TABELLA DEXTRA Panels
description: Two stacked panel woodcuts: TABELLA DEXTRA showing figures at a doorway and TABELLA SINISTRA showing an outdoor scene.
narrative_context: Side panels of the procession — left and right views of a passing triumph.

label: PARS ANTERIOR ET POSTERIOR
description: Two-panel woodcut showing front and rear views of figures in processional arrangement.
narrative_context: Front and back views of another section of the procession.

label: TRIVMPHVS: Lovers' Chariot
description: Large triumphal chariot bearing reclining lovers embraced among garlands and putti. The emotional climax of the procession.
narrative_context: The central image of the procession — lovers entwined on a triumphal chariot, representing the ultimate victory of Eros.

label: TABELLA DEXTRA (Second Set)
description: Two stacked panels showing processional scenes with figures at doorways and in landscapes.
narrative_context: Additional processional panels.

label: PARS ANTERIOR ET POSTERIOR (Second)
description: Small woodcut showing front and rear views of processional figures.
narrative_context: Another paired-view panel in the procession sequence.

label: TRIVMPHVS with Triple Panels
description: Large chariot woodcut at top plus two TABELLA DEXTRA/SINISTRA panels below.
narrative_context: The most densely illustrated page in the procession.

label: TERTIVS: Ox Procession
description: Two stacked panels showing a procession with oxen and figures carrying implements.
narrative_context: An agricultural/sacrificial section of the procession, with oxen suggesting ritual sacrifice.

label: Nymphs Approaching Altar
description: Procession of nymphs approaching an altar or sacrificial table with trees and architecture.
narrative_context: A ritual scene marking the transition from procession to ceremony.

label: Festive Scene at Fountain
description: Festive scene with figures gathered around a fountain in a garden setting.
narrative_context: Post-processional celebration.

label: Bacchic Triumphal Chariot
description: Large Bacchic triumphal chariot with Maenads, Satyrs, and Dionysiac figures.
narrative_context: The Bacchic triumph — Dionysus as the complement to Apollo's ordered beauty.

label: QVARTVS: Feasting Chariot
description: Chariot with reclining figures feasting among garlands, fruit, and flowing drapery.
narrative_context: The fourth triumph: a feast on wheels.

label: Worship of Priapus
description: Full-page woodcut: nineteen female and five male figures worshipping at a shrine of Priapus.
narrative_context: The Priapus worship scene marks the transition from procession to temple ritual.

label: Section and Ground-plan of Rotunda Temple
description: Full-page architectural diagram: cross-section and floor plan of the circular Temple of Venus Physizoa.
narrative_context: The HP's most elaborate architectural diagram.

label: Winged Female Half-figure Ornament
description: Nude winged female half-figure emerging from acanthus foliage. Decorative architectural element.
narrative_context: A decorative motif from the temple interior.

label: Globular Lamp Hung in Chains
description: Ornate spherical lamp suspended by chains. Detailed metalwork design.
narrative_context: A lighting fixture from the Temple of Venus.

label: Crowning of Lantern in Cupola
description: Architectural ornament: the lantern crowning the temple cupola, with bells and decorative finial.
narrative_context: The crowning element of the temple dome.

label: Inscribed Tablets in Temple
description: Two inscribed cartouches with Greek and Latin text. Hieroglyphic devices in the Temple of Venus.
narrative_context: Inscribed tablets within the temple.

label: Procession of Seven Virgins to Altar
description: Seven virgins in procession approaching the altar in the Temple of Venus. Ritual scene with priestess.
narrative_context: The beginning of the Venus temple ceremony.

label: Polia's Torch Extinguished in Altar-fountain
description: Ceremony scene: Polia extinguishes a torch in the fountain at the altar. Priestess and attendants present.
narrative_context: Polia's torch-extinguishing symbolizes the surrender of Diana's chastity to Venus's love.

label: Temple Ceremony at Altar
description: Figures gathered around the altar in the Temple of Venus. Ritual scene under classical portico.
narrative_context: Continuation of the temple ceremony.

label: Two Virgins Offering Swans and Doves
description: Two virgins offering swans and doves for sacrifice at the temple altar. Priestess officiates.
narrative_context: The sacrifice of birds sacred to Venus.

label: The Altar in the Temple of Venus
description: Detailed view of the altar/vessel on its pedestal in the Temple of Venus.
narrative_context: The altar itself as an object of contemplation.

label: Temple Ceremony: Miracle of the Roses
description: Ceremony scene in the temple. Figures gathered around altar as roses appear.
narrative_context: The miracle of the roses: a rose-tree rises from the altar.

label: Sacrifice Scene with Swans at Altar
description: Ceremony at temple altar: priestess officiates as swans are sacrificed.
narrative_context: The culminating sacrifice in the Temple of Venus.

label: Poliphilus and Polia Receive Fruits
description: Poliphilus and Polia receive fruits from the priestess at the altar. Completion of the temple ceremony.
narrative_context: The lovers receive the fruits of their devotion.

label: Miracle of the Roses (Full Scene)
description: Rose-tree rising from altar. Priestess on ladder tending the miraculous tree. Figures kneel in worship below.
narrative_context: The miracle of the roses is the climax of the temple ceremony.

label: Poliphilus and Polia Receive Fruits from Priestess
description: Poliphilus and Polia receive ceremonial fruits from the priestess under the temple portico.
narrative_context: The final gift from the priestess seals the lovers' union.

label: Ruins of Temple Polyandrion
description: Full-page woodcut: ruined classical temple among trees. Obelisk visible. Fallen columns and arches.
narrative_context: The Polyandrion (cemetery of lovers) — the HP's most romantic archaeological vision.

label: Obelisk with Hieroglyphic Devices
description: Obelisk with hieroglyphic inscriptions plus circular medallion with Latin text.
narrative_context: The Polyandrion begins with an obelisk covered in hieroglyphics.

label: Hieroglyphic Device Strip and Julius Caesar Medallion
description: Two woodcuts: strip of small hieroglyphic figures AND circular medallion with DIVO IVLIO CAESARI inscription.
narrative_context: Julius Caesar medallion combines Roman imperial epigraphy with natural history.

label: Two Hieroglyphic Medallion Reliefs
description: Two circular medallions with figural scenes: MILITARIS PRVDENTIA and DIVVLII VICTORIAR.
narrative_context: Paired medallions from the Polyandrion, combining military virtue with love's victory.

label: Polyandrion Architrave Fragment
description: Architrave fragment with inscription CADAVERIS AMORE FVRENTIVM MISERABVNDIS POLYANDRION.
narrative_context: The naming inscription of the Polyandrion: a cemetery for those who died raving from love.

label: Cupola Above Entrance to the Crypt
description: Domed cupola structure with columns marking the entrance to the underground crypt.
narrative_context: The entrance to the crypt beneath the Polyandrion.

label: Sarcophagus: Interno Plotoni
description: Sarcophagus with inscription INTERNO PLOTONI TRICORPORI. Classical funerary monument.
narrative_context: A sarcophagus dedicated to Pluto, ruler of the underworld.

label: Mosaic of Hell on Crypt Ceiling
description: Large arched scene: mosaic depicting Hell on the ceiling of the crypt. Figures in torment among flames and darkness.
narrative_context: The Hell mosaic, after Dante.

label: Sepulchral Monument: D.M. Annirae
description: Architectural monument with urn and inscription D.M. ANNIRAE PVCILLAE. Cherub faces on pedestal.
narrative_context: A funerary monument for a young girl.

label: Sacrifice Relief: Have Seria Obitum
description: Relief panel with figures: old man, youth, faun, and dancers. Inscription HAVE SERIA OBITVM.
narrative_context: A relief depicting a funerary sacrifice.

label: Epitaph Fragments with Urn
description: Two epitaph fragments: HEVS INSPECTO FACIO inscription and Greek inscription urn.
narrative_context: Multiple epitaphs showcasing the HP's multilingual epigraphy.

label: Sepulchral Monument with Latin Inscription
description: Tombstone on stepped pedestal with Latin epitaph.
narrative_context: A classical Roman-style funerary monument.

label: Epitaphs: Greek Urn and D.M. Lyndia
description: Two woodcuts: sepulchral urn with Greek inscription AND tombstone with epitaph D.M. LYNDIA.
narrative_context: Paired epitaphs continuing the Polyandrion sequence.

label: Sarcophagus: P. Cornelia Annia
description: Elaborate sarcophagus with inscription D.M. P.CORNELIA ANNIA NE INDESOLATA. Tiled roof detail.
narrative_context: A grand sarcophagus with architectural frame suggesting a miniature temple.

label: Sarcophagus with Hieroglyphic Devices
description: Sarcophagus decorated with hieroglyphic symbols and devices.
narrative_context: An Egyptian-themed sarcophagus connecting funerary arts of Rome and Egypt.

label: Large Epitaph: O Lector Infoelix
description: Full-page epitaph within ornate architectural frame. Extended Latin inscription beginning O LECTOR INFOEL...
narrative_context: The longest epitaph in the Polyandrion. The reader is directly addressed as 'unhappy reader'.

label: Sepulchral Monument with Laurel Wreath
description: Large sepulchral monument crowned with laurel wreath.
narrative_context: A monument crowned with the laurel of poetic glory.

label: Monument of Artemisia
description: Full-page woodcut: elaborate architectural monument with Queen Artemisia enthroned in central niche.
narrative_context: The monument of Artemisia, who drank the ashes of her husband Mausolus.

label: Sepulchral Monument with Putti
description: Elaborate sepulchral monument with two putti holding curtain. Arched niche with figure.
narrative_context: A grand funerary monument combining classical framing with putti and drapery.

label: Epitaph with Busts of Youth and Woman
description: Sepulchral monument with portrait busts. Latin epitaph: ASPICE VIATOR...
narrative_context: A double portrait monument for two lovers.

label: Sepulchral Portal: Gates of Life and Death
description: Full-page monument: architectural portal with eagle pediment, inscription D.DITI ET PROSER. Two gates below.
narrative_context: The portal of Dis and Proserpina, with the narrow gates of life and death.

label: Standard of Cupid's Bark
description: Decorative banner with AMOR VINCIT OMNIA inscription.
narrative_context: The banner of Cupid's ship, proclaiming love conquers all.

label: The Bark of the God of Love
description: Small boat on waves with ornamental prow and stern. Cupid's vessel for the voyage to Cythera.
narrative_context: Cupid's bark, carrying Poliphilo and Polia across the sea to Venus's island.

label: Water-work Fountain with Hydra Heads
description: Ornate fountain structure with multiple water spouts, hydra-headed decorations, and peristyle columns.
narrative_context: A garden fountain on Venus's island, combining hydraulic engineering with mythological ornament.

label: Tree Clipped in Ring-shape
description: Topiary: tree shaped into a ring on ornamental base with pedestal.
narrative_context: The first of the HP's remarkable topiary illustrations.

label: Box-tree Clipped as Mushroom
description: Topiary: box-tree clipped into mushroom shape on stepped circular pedestal.
narrative_context: Another topiary design from Venus's gardens.

label: Peristyle Colonnade with Trellis
description: Classical peristyle structure with trellis and garden setting.
narrative_context: A garden architecture combining classical columns with horticultural trellis work.

label: Plan of the Island of Venus
description: Full-page diagram: circular plan of Venus's island showing concentric garden zones and central temple.
narrative_context: The plan of Venus's island, with concentric rings of gardens surrounding the central sanctuary.

label: Ornamental Flower-bed Pattern (Circular)
description: Circular ornamental flower-bed design with concentric rings of geometric patterns.
narrative_context: One of the HP's garden-design diagrams.

label: Ornamental Flower-bed Pattern (Square)
description: Square flower-bed design with geometric interlocking patterns.
narrative_context: A square flower-bed design complementing the circular pattern.

label: Peacock Topiary on Pedestal
description: Box-tree clipped as three peacocks standing on ornamental altar-vase pedestal.
narrative_context: A topiary peacock, combining horticultural imagination with the symbolic associations of the peacock.

label: Flower-bed in Shape of Eagle
description: Flower-bed pattern shaped as an eagle with spread wings.
narrative_context: An eagle-shaped parterre, combining heraldic imagery with horticultural design.

label: Eagle and Urn Flower-bed Design
description: Flower-bed pattern with eagle/urn motif. Latin inscription around border.
narrative_context: An eagle-and-urn parterre design.

label: Two Trophy Standards
description: Two vertical trophy standards side by side: Roman arms trophies with ornamental designs.
narrative_context: Garden trophies combining military and decorative motifs.

label: Trophy Standards: QVIS EVADET and NEMO
description: Two vertical trophy standards. Tablets inscribed QVIS EVADET and NEMO.
narrative_context: Paired trophies posing the enigmatic question 'Who shall escape?' answered by 'No one.'

label: Trophy Standards with NEMO Tablet
description: Two more trophy standards with tablets inscribed NEMO.
narrative_context: Trophies bearing the enigmatic inscription NEMO (no one).

label: Vase with Dragon-handle Monsters
description: Ornate two-handled vase with dragon-form handles. Detailed metalwork with mythological motifs.
narrative_context: A remarkable vessel combining the HP's obsession with decorative arts and mythological fauna.

label: Earthenware Amphora with Fumes
description: Amphora with odoriferous fumes emerging from orifice. Greek inscription PANTA BAIA BIOY.
narrative_context: An amphora emitting fragrant smoke, inscribed 'All of life is brief.' Perfume and mortality united.

label: Precious Stone Vase with Fiery Sparks
description: Small ornate vase of precious stone emitting fiery sparks or fumes.
narrative_context: A remarkable vessel combining precious materials with alchemical imagery.

label: Terminal Figure with Three Male Heads
description: Classical herm/terminal figure on pedestal. Three male heads facing different directions.
narrative_context: A garden herm, the three heads perhaps representing past, present, and future.

label: Terminal Figure with Serpent
description: Terminal figure/trophy with serpent and ornamental elements. Three heads of Cerberus visible.
narrative_context: A terminal figure combining classical herm tradition with infernal imagery.

label: Triumph of Cupid: Nymphs and Satyrs with Chariot
description: Procession with nymphs and satyrs pulling chariot bearing Cupid. Captives and trophies.
narrative_context: A second triumphal procession on Venus's island.

label: Triumph of Cupid
description: Large procession: nymphs, satyrs, dragons, and captives in Cupid's triumphal procession.
narrative_context: Cupid rides in triumph over all who love.

label: Column Base with Rams' Heads
description: Architectural detail: column base with rams' heads and sacrifice medallion relief.
narrative_context: A column base from the amphitheater.

label: The Amphitheatre in Island of Venus
description: Large architectural section: amphitheater structure with tiered seating, arches, and columns.
narrative_context: The amphitheater on Venus's island.

label: Ground-plan of Fountain of Venus
description: Geometric diagram: heptagonal/octagonal ground-plan of the fountain of Venus.
narrative_context: The plan of Venus's central fountain.

label: Poliphilus and Polia at Fountain of Venus
description: Garden scene: Poliphilus and Polia with nymphs at the Fountain of Venus.
narrative_context: The lovers arrive at the culminating fountain.

label: Polia Drags Prostrate Poliphilus
description: Interior scene: Polia drags the prostrate Poliphilus from the sanctuary of Diana. Classical temple columns.
narrative_context: Polia's act of physical rescue precedes her spiritual surrender to love.

label: Polia in Temple of Diana; Poliphilus Prostrate
description: Temple interior: Poliphilus lies prostrate on the floor while Polia stands in the Temple of Diana.
narrative_context: Poliphilus has collapsed at Polia's feet in Diana's temple.

label: Cupid Brandishes Sword over Victims
description: Cupid brandishes a sword over kneeling women bound to trees. Chariot visible at right.
narrative_context: Cupid's punishment of those who resist love.

label: Lion, Dog, Dragon Devour Victims
description: Woodland scene: lion, dog, and dragon devour victims while Cupid flies above with torch and arrows.
narrative_context: The most violent image in the HP: beasts destroy those who defy love.

label: Dream of Polia: Cupid Punishes Two Women
description: Two women punished by Cupid in a woodland setting. Figures tied to trees with beasts approaching.
narrative_context: Polia's vision of Cupid's vengeance.

label: Poliphilus Dead; Polia Kneels in Grief
description: Interior scene: Poliphilus lies dead on tiled floor while Polia kneels beside him in grief.
narrative_context: The central crisis of Book II.

label: Poliphilus Revived in Polia's Lap
description: Interior scene: Polia cradles the revived Poliphilus in her lap.
narrative_context: Poliphilus revives in Polia's arms — a resurrection through love paralleling the alchemical solve et coagula.

label: Priestesses Drive Lovers from Temple
description: Figures being driven from a classical temple entrance. Priestesses expel the lovers from Diana's sanctuary.
narrative_context: The priestesses of Diana expel Poliphilus and Polia.

label: Polia's Bed-chamber Vision
description: Two-scene woodcut: landscape with figures above, Polia in bed-chamber below. Diana vs Venus contest in sky.
narrative_context: Polia's pivotal vision: Diana and Venus contend for her allegiance.
